description: Turn HTML created by your agent into a shareable report, presentation, brief, or explainer. Share Artifacts publishes static HTML, lets you update an artifact while keeping its link, and provides tools to manage sharing and revoke access. Artifacts are owner-private by default. Choose public or restricted sharing when you are ready to share. Published content is sanitized and served on a separate content origin. JavaScript, forms, embeds, and active API calls are disabled. Connect to the hosted MCP service and authorize access to your own Share Artifacts account.
